reviews_captured_by_me.text: Kelly was absolutely amazing!  He completely gutted our kitchen, relocated our fridge, took out part of a wall, installed floors, lighting, cabinets, appliances - everything he told us from the start regarding timing and installation was spot on.  He is a true craftsman.  Going through a complete kitchen remodel is a stressful time, and I’ve heard horror stories from friends, but Kelly made ours so easy.  I wish I could give 6 stars, seriously . Thanks Kelly!
